context: Data visualization — bee swarm plot of 500 company revenues on a log scale with scale-toggle interaction (Log/Linear/Symlog) and an integrated box plot summary
first_impression: Thoughtful and interactive, with a deliberate colorblind-safe palette and clean typography, but the swarm occupies only the upper half of the chart area leaving an awkward expanse of dead space below
what_works: Tol colorblind-safe palette is intentional and harmonious rather than default schemeCategory10; the scale toggle with animated re-simulation plus integrated box plot is a genuinely educational feature that earns every element it adds
what_doesnt: The force simulation leaves roughly half the vertical data area empty — the swarm hugs the upper portion while a large blank void sits between it and the box plot, making the layout feel unbalanced and buggy; dot opacity 0.8 with white strokes on a light background means the densest cluster around $1M reads as a muddy mass with little individual dot legibility
